product.title: Deluxe Arizona Memorial and USS Missouri Battleship Tour

description.text: A small group leaves a Waikiki hotel for Pearl Harbor, the USS Arizona Memorial, and the Battleship Missouri. The transfer uses an air-conditioned vehicle, and tickets for the USS Arizona Memorial and the USS Missouri, also called the Mighty MO, are included. The day includes a short ride through downtown Honolulu. Time aboard the battleship follows pickup at the Waikiki hotel on this Oahu tour. Downtown Honolulu is a short ride on the same air-conditioned day as the Arizona Memorial and the Mighty MO.
